title: Exploring the Ancient Wonder of Sigiriya
description: Discover the breathtaking beauty and rich history of Sigiriya, the Lion Rock fortress.
author: Tourvir Team
content: Sigiriya is one of the most remarkable historical monuments in Sri Lanka. It rises 200 meters above the surrounding jungle and offers incredible views. Visitors can climb to the top to explore the ancient ruins of the palace built by King Kasyapa in the 5th century. Don't miss the famous frescoes halfway up the rock, and the giant lion paws guarding the final ascent. This UNESCO World Heritage site is a must-visit for any traveler to Sri Lanka.
